_net_comment: advertiseHost overrides the host used in advertising/callback URLs; set mdnsInterface only when the host's default multicast egress uses the wrong NIC (e.g. Windows+Tailscale); do not set mdnsInterface on hosts with multiple addresses on the same subnet.
_a2a_comment: All fields below are optional; omit them to use defaults. A2A JSON-RPC over HTTP; the shared secret is used as the Bearer token.
_cluster_comment: Remote workspaces/sessions (cluster): a peer may provision a working copy on this host and open/prompt a pi session inside it. This is remote code execution with this user's permissions — bound it with allowRemoteWorkspace and/or workspaceRoots.
